Title: Azure Machine Learning - General Availability for Build 2024

Body.Content:
One new feature now available in GA enables you to create and customize AI workflows using task-specific Language skills/models to complete business use cases. 

Use Language tools and sample flows available in Prompt Flow tooling You can now promptly get bootstrapped with Language services, significantly reducing your time to market, and confidently deploy solutions with trustworthy evaluations.
